en-US.name: Karpathy Guidelines
en-US.summary: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations
en-US.description: Pinned commit 2c606141936f1eeef17fa3043a72095b4765b9c2 has no standalone LICENSE. The previous review accepted the one-line MIT declaration in README; the installed SKILL.md also explicitly declares license: MIT on line 4. Correct the evidence path to that original in-scope file rather than downgrading solely for a missing standalone LICENSE. This neither invents full MIT text nor generalizes to other snapshots. Upstream files and install method are unchanged.

zh-CN.description: 固定提交 2c606141936f1eeef17fa3043a72095b4765b9c2 无独立 LICENSE 文件。原审核接受 README 的一行 MIT 声明；复核发现实际安装路径内 SKILL.md 第 4 行同样明确 license: MIT，故将许可证据路径纠正到该原始文件，不因没有独立 LICENSE 而一刀切降级。本条不是补写 MIT 全文或泛化到其他固定版本。未改上游文件或安装方式。
